segments.source: A screenshot of a Git blame window from the Visual Studio Code editor.
segments.translation: Visual Studio Code 에디터의 Git blame 창을 캡처한 스크린샷입니다.

segments.source: The git blame shows the line "#define BINPRM_BUF_SIZE 128" being changed to 256.
segments.translation: Git blame에서 "#define BINPRM_BUF_SIZE 128" 줄이 256으로 변경되는 것을 보여줍니다.

segments.source: The commit is by Oleg Nesterov, and the main text is "exec: increase BINPRM_BUF_SIZE to 256.
segments.translation: 이 커밋은 Oleg Nesterov가 작성했으며, 본문 내용은 "exec: increase BINPRM_BUF_SIZE to 256.

segments.source: Large enterprise clients often run applications out of networked file systems where the IT mandated layout of project volumes can end up leading to paths that are longer than 128 characters.
segments.translation: Large enterprise clients often run applications out of networked file systems where the IT mandated layout of project volumes can end up leading to paths that are longer than 128 characters.

segments.source: Bumping this up to the next order of two solves this problem in all but the most egregious case while still fitting into a 512b slab." The commit is signed off by Linus Torvalds, among others.
segments.translation: Bumping this up to the next order of two solves this problem in all but the most egregious case while still fitting into a 512b slab."입니다. 이 커밋은 Linus Torvalds 등 여러 사람의 서명을 받았습니다.
